fields.display_title: This paper proposes a knowledge distillation framework to achieve efficient object recognition when adapting a large model to a new scenario. It features in an adaption module to learn a binary student network and an attention triplet loss to guide the student network to focuse on semantic information. It mimics the data adaptation scenario by splititing the datasets CIFAR-100 and Tiny-Imagenet into inliner and outliner classes and shows improvement over the baseline on multiple metrics.
